full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph looks straight up a sunlit suburban driveway toward a white older car parked beneath a broad leafy tree. The foreground is a pale, rough driveway that widens toward the lower edge, its gravelly surface broken by soft tire tracks and irregular darker patches. The car sits slightly right of center with its rear facing the camera. Its light roof and trunk stand out against the shadowed fence, and small round rear lights form a simple dark rhythm across the back. A compact shadow lies beneath it and falls a little toward the viewer. Behind the car, the tree's dark trunk divides into thick branches that support a large, bright canopy occupying much of the upper half. The foliage appears almost silvery in the hard sun, with small leaves merging into a textured cloud against a middle-gray sky. On the left, a telephone pole and thin wires cut across the open sky above a narrow strip of shrubs and fence. On the right, a simple low building with a pitched roof borders the driveway; darker open structures sit behind the car. Nothing has been tidied into a perfect arrangement: everyday fences, plants, utility lines, and worn ground remain visible. Strong midday light creates bright leaf edges, a washed pale road, and sharply darker shade under the tree and car. The tonal range runs from luminous silver-white to deep black without losing the fine grain of the photographic print. No people or readable text are apparent. The overall composition is ordinary and direct, with a central canopy and parked car organizing a quiet scene of suburban stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白纪实照片正面望向受阳光照亮的郊区车道，一辆白色旧车停在宽大的绿叶树下。前景是一直扩展到下缘的浅色粗糙车道，砂砾般的表面被浅浅车辙和不规则深斑打断。汽车稍偏中央右侧，车尾朝向镜头。浅色车顶和后备箱在背阴栅栏前突出，几只小圆尾灯在车尾排出简洁的深色节奏。紧凑的影子落在车下，并略向观者方向延伸。车后，深色树干分出粗壮枝条，托起占据上半部大部分空间的明亮树冠。硬质阳光下，树叶近乎银白，小叶片聚成中灰天空前一团富有纹理的云状形体。左侧一根电线杆和细电线切过开阔天空，下方是狭窄的灌丛与栅栏。右侧，一座屋顶倾斜的简单矮建筑贴着车道；汽车后面还有更暗的敞开式结构。这里没有被收拾成完美的陈列，日常的围栏、植物、公用线路和磨旧地面都保留下来。强烈的正午光带来发亮的叶缘、泛白的道路，以及树下与车下明显更深的阴影。明度从发光的银白走到深黑，同时保留摄影照片的细颗粒。画面看不见人物或可读文字。整体构图寻常而直接，以中央树冠和停着的汽车组织一幅安静的郊区景象。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photograph treats ordinary space with a level, direct view and generous natural light. Bright silvery textures sit beside dense, clearly located shadows, creating a full tonal scale without theatrical lighting. Fine photographic grain and modest softness hold small details together while leaving larger silhouettes easy to read. Thin linear marks cross broad open gray areas, and irregular textured masses counter the simple horizontals and verticals below. Depth arises from a broad pale foreground narrowing toward layered middle-distance forms; the framing remains casual rather than geometrically perfect. Highlights can be slightly washed by sun, while dark pockets retain enough structure to describe surfaces. The visual effect is quiet and alert, finding formal balance in an unstaged, everyday arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白摄影以平视、直接的视角和充足的自然光对待寻常空间。明亮的银白色纹理紧邻浓重且位置明确的阴影，形成完整明度范围，却没有戏剧化照明。细摄影颗粒和适度柔和感将小细节联在一起，同时让大剪影容易辨认。细线性痕迹穿过宽阔的开放灰色区域，不规则的纹理色块与下方简单的纵横形体相平衡。纵深来自宽阔浅色前景向分层中景逐渐收窄；取景保持随意，而非几何上的完美。高光可以被阳光稍稍冲白，暗处仍保留足以说明表面的结构。视觉效果安静而敏锐，在未经布置的日常排列中找到形式平衡。
theme_en: A white vintage car in a sunlit suburban driveway beneath a broad tree
theme_zh: 宽大树冠下、停在阳光郊区车道里的白色旧车
name: Henry Wessel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
